summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 01 October 2026 regarding the allotment and admission to trading of 4,522,400 ordinary shares of 10p each (ISIN GB0008706128) issued between 1 September and 30 September 2026 to satisfy awards under the Company's share plans. The shares were admitted under existing block admissions dated 22 May 2025, 24 November 2025 and 27 May 2026, bringing total shares admitted to trading to 57,595,621,161 as at close of business on 30 September 2026. This is a routine equity issuance notification, not a special situation; no price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or deal terms were stated.
